scope: Repair the generated ASCII/Binary DXF layout-graph control after the current UCS parser correctly rejected an orthographic origin without its selector.

implementation.change: The in-memory UCS table-record generator now emits a valid group-71 selector before its complete group-13/23/33 orthographic-origin tuple; assertions verify the captured type and coordinates.

diagnosis.before: The focused libdxfrw_dxf_fixtures CTest failed in ASCII and Binary at the first group 13, before any UCS or OBJECTS callback. The generated control emitted 13/23/33 without a preceding group 71.
diagnosis.cause: The UCS parser requires each orthographic-origin tuple to have a preceding selector and exactly one value for each of 13, 23, and 33. This is a test-input defect, not a production parser defect.
diagnosis.after: The owning CTest passes after the generator was corrected.

evidenceLimit: This is generated DXF parser regression coverage and a repair to a test control only. It is not a new producer witness, independent semantic result, geometry qualification, DWG result, or support promotion.
gitCommitNote: Repository Git metadata is read-only in the current environment; the shared worktree remains uncommitted and other user changes were preserved.
